discussion_points.summary: 18 of 22 story points completed (82% velocity); 3 stories carried over: AUTH-451, DASH-298, API-117; AUTH-451 blocked by third-party SSO provider delay; overall project is on track for March 28 beta release.

New analytics dashboard demonstrated with real-time data visualization; stakeholder feedback was positive with request for additional filtering; chart rendering performance improved by 40% using canvas-based approach; mobile responsive layout needs refinement for tablets.

Load test handled 5,000 concurrent users against a 3,000 target; average API response time was 142ms against a target of under 200ms; a memory leak was identified in the WebSocket connection handler; database query optimization is needed for report generation, currently 3.2s.
Sprint 15 will focus on authentication module completion and API stabilization; estimated capacity is 20 story points; priority items are SSO integration, rate limiting, and audit logging.
